verdict.rationale: Community users credit Jira with its own query capability: JQL and useful queries over Jira data via REST. This gives some evidence of structured search over tasks, but there is no first-party documentation of search across docs or comments. One user calls building a useful saved search 'painful', and general reports of slowness undercut the 'fast' claim. Missing for 10: first-party docs on global or cross-product search, evidence of searching docs and comments, evidence of fast and accurate results, and independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: One of the things I like most about Jira is the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there.
That's what I appreciate most about Jira.
